thread:
andrea: quick sanity check — we're planning to remove the implicit default model on POST /v1/generate next Wed. clients without an Accept-Model header will start getting a 409. deprecation window proposed: warning for 2 weeks, enforced in 6 weeks. any immediate concerns?

mike: do we have a list of customers who rely on implicit default? worried about breaking hosted apps. :eyes:

andrea: we have telemetry for requests without Accept-Model header, ~0.6% of traffic. mostly small apps and a few enterprise test suites. I'll share query later.

sasha: suggest a soft-warning first: still accept requests but add response header `Warning: 299 Redwood; \"default-model-deprecation\"` and a body field `deprecated_default_used: true` for 2 weeks so SDKs and logs pick it up.

jon: runtime note — supporting silent fallback to a specific model for some customers is doable but expensive; autoswitching adds complexity to routing and billing. we should avoid auto-upgrade to larger models.

emma: docs side — I have a PR draft for migration guide and sample code. will add examples for server & client pinning. sample snippet:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Accept-Model: redwood/fast-2.1" \
  -d '{"prompt":"..."}'
```

oliver: SDKs need a release that sets a sensible default (e.g., include Accept-Model header with pinned version) so older SDK apps don't break when server starts enforcing. we'll need a major/minor bump depending on semver rules.

andrea: proposed action items: 1) infra signal query (mike) to list top customers using implicit default, 2) add warning header + response body flag (sasha + jon runtime), 3) docs & migration PR (emma), 4) SDK release plan (oliver). target: warning rollout next Tue, enforcement in 6 weeks.

mike: I can run the query by EOD and DM product for outreach list.

sasha: I'll put up the warning header patch and a toggle behind `feature.toggle.deprecate_default_model` so we can roll back if needed.

jon: can do runtime toggle and metric to count 409s vs warnings. also add circuit breaker to prevent a flood of 409s.

emma: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 — will add migration checklist and FAQ. ping me for wording. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary deploy of warning header to staging tonight 02:00 UTC. will post results.

andrea: thumbs up. once mike has list we'll decide if we need targeted emails. thanks everyone.

oliver: one more ask — add a compatibility header for client versions that already set Accept-Model so we can ignore them in the outreach: `X-Client-Accept-Model: true`. small change to SDKs.

andrea: noted. adding to the checklist.

docs-bot: docs build succeeded for PR 412, preview at https://docs.redwood.ai/preview/412

mike: query results: 18 orgs with >1000 requests/day using implicit default, 740 apps with sporadic usage. I'll share as CSV to #customer-success.

andrea: perfect — will draft outreach next week. thanks all. :sparkles:
